question_en: Four equal charges $+q$ sit at the corners of a square of side $a$. What is the potential at the centre of the square?
question_uz: Tomoni $a$ bo'lgan kvadrat uchlarida to'rtta bir xil $+q$ zaryad turibdi. Kvadrat markazidagi potensial nimaga teng?
question_ru: В вершинах квадрата со стороной $a$ находятся четыре одинаковых заряда $+q$. Чему равен потенциал в центре квадрата?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Har bir zaryad markazdan a/√2 masofada, potensiallar skalyar qo'shiladi: 4kq·√2/a. Maydon nol, potensial emas.
Asos: superpozitsiya.

distractors.A: maydon nol bo'lgani uchun potensial ham nol deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: раз поле нулевое, потенциал взят нулевым

distractors_en.A: the potential was taken as zero because the field is
distractors_en.C: the distance was taken as a·√2 (the diagonal)
distractors_en.D: the distance was taken as a

source: original (B2-L13, kvadrat markazi)

question_en: A proton and an alpha particle (charge $2e$, mass $4m_p$) are accelerated from rest through the same voltage. What is the ratio of the proton's speed to the alpha particle's speed?
question_uz: Proton va alfa-zarra (zaryadi $2e$, massasi $4m_p$) tinch holatdan bir xil kuchlanish bilan tezlatildi. Proton tezligining alfa-zarra tezligiga nisbati nimaga teng?
question_ru: Протон и альфа-частица (заряд $2e$, масса $4m_p$) ускорены из состояния покоя одинаковым напряжением. Чему равно отношение скорости протона к скорости альфа-частицы?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. v = √(2qU/m) ∝ √(q/m): proton uchun e/m, alfa uchun 2e/4m = e/2m. Nisbat √2.
Asos: energiya saqlanishi.

distractors_en.A: q/m was inverted and the root dropped
distractors_en.B: the square root was not taken
distractors_en.D: the energies were taken as equal
distractors_en.E: only the mass ratio was used

source: original (B2-L13, proton va alfa-zarra)

question_en: What is the ratio of the potential at the centre of a ball uniformly charged throughout its volume to the potential at its surface ($\varphi=0$ at infinity)?
question_uz: Hajmi bo'ylab bir tekis zaryadlangan shar markazidagi potensialning shar sirtidagi potensialga nisbati qancha (cheksizlikda $\varphi=0$)?
question_ru: Каково отношение потенциала в центре равномерно заряженного по объёму шара к потенциалу на его поверхности ($\varphi=0$ на бесконечности)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Ichkarida φ = kQ(3R² − r²)/(2R³): markazda 3kQ/(2R), sirtda kQ/R. Nisbat 3/2.
Asos: bir jinsli shar potensiali.

distractors.B: shar ichida maydon nol deb olingan (sfera kabi)

distractors_ru.B: поле внутри шара взято нулевым (как у сферы)

distractors_en.B: the field inside was taken as zero (as for a shell)
distractors_en.D: the interior field was taken as kQ/r²

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», shar potensiali g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A charged parallel-plate capacitor is disconnected from the source, and then the plate separation is increased by a factor of $2$. By what factor does its energy change?
question_uz: Zaryadlangan yassi kondensator manbadan uzildi, so'ng qoplamalari orasidagi masofa $2$ marta oshirildi. Kondensator energiyasi necha marta o'zgaradi?
question_ru: Заряженный плоский конденсатор отключили от источника, затем расстояние между обкладками увеличили в $2$ раза. Во сколько раз изменится энергия конденсатора?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Q o'zgarmas, C = ε₀A/d ikki marta kamayadi, W = Q²/(2C) ikki marta ortadi — ish tortishishga qarshi bajariladi.
Asos: kondensator energiyasi.

distractors_en.C: energy was assumed to be conserved

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 8.35-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: With a parallel-plate capacitor connected to a constant-voltage source, the plate separation is increased by a factor of $2$. By what factor does its energy change?
question_uz: Yassi kondensator o'zgarmas kuchlanishli manbaga ulangan holda qoplamalari orasidagi masofa $2$ marta oshirildi. Kondensator energiyasi necha marta o'zgaradi?
question_ru: Плоский конденсатор, подключённый к источнику постоянного напряжения, раздвинули: расстояние между обкладками увеличили в $2$ раза. Во сколько раз изменится энергия конденсатора?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. U o'zgarmas, C ikki marta kamayadi, W = CU²/2 ham ikki marta kamayadi; zaryadning bir qismi manbaga qaytadi.
Asos: kondensator energiyasi.
source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 8.37-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A point charge $q$ is a distance $d$ from a grounded infinite conducting plane. What is the magnitude of the force on the charge?
question_uz: Nuqtaviy $q$ zaryad yerga ulangan cheksiz o'tkazgich tekislikdan $d$ masofada turibdi. Zaryadga ta'sir qiluvchi kuch kattaligi qancha?
question_ru: Точечный заряд $q$ находится на расстоянии $d$ от заземлённой бесконечной проводящей плоскости. Какова величина силы, действующей на заряд?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Tekislikni −q tasvir zaryad bilan almashtiramiz; ular orasidagi masofa 2d: F = kq²/(4d²), tortishish.
Asos: tasvirlar usuli.

distractors.D: yerga ulangan tekislik ta'sir qilmaydi deb o'ylangan
distractors.E: ikki marta hisoblangan va masofa d

distractors_ru.D: считается, что заземлённая плоскость не действует

distractors_en.A: the separation was taken as d
distractors_en.D: it was assumed a grounded plane exerts no force

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», tasvirlar usuli g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: Two metal spheres of radii $R$ and $2R$ are far apart and joined by a thin wire. Their total charge is $Q$. What is the charge on the smaller sphere?
question_uz: Radiuslari $R$ va $2R$ bo'lgan ikki metall shar bir-biridan uzoqda turibdi va ingichka sim bilan ulangan. Ularning umumiy zaryadi $Q$. Kichik shardagi zaryad qancha?
question_ru: Два металлических шара радиусами $R$ и $2R$ находятся далеко друг от друга и соединены тонкой проволокой. Их общий заряд $Q$. Каков заряд на малом шаре?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Potensiallar teng: q₁/R = q₂/(2R), q₂ = 2q₁; q₁ + q₂ = Q dan q₁ = Q/3.
Asos: o'tkazgich ekvipotensial.

distractors.D: zaryad sirt yuziga proporsional deb olingan, nisbat 1:4

distractors_en.D: the charge was taken proportional to area, 1:4
distractors_en.E: the surface densities were taken as equal

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 7.63-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: An isolated metal sphere of radius $R$ carries a charge $Q$. How much energy is stored in its electric field?
question_uz: Radiusi $R$ bo'lgan yakkalangan metall sferada $Q$ zaryad bor. Uning elektr maydonida to'plangan energiya qancha?
question_ru: На уединённой металлической сфере радиусом $R$ находится заряд $Q$. Какова энергия, запасённая в её электрическом поле?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. C = R/k, W = Q²/(2C) = kQ²/(2R); yoki maydon energiyasini r > R bo'yicha integrallash.
Asos: maydon energiyasi.

en: The field is only outside: $$W=\frac{\varepsilon_0}{2}\int_R^\infty E^2\cdot4\pi r^2dr=\frac{kQ^2}{2R}$$

distractors_en.C: the energy of a uniformly charged ball

source: original (B2-L13, sfera energiyasi)

question_en: Far from a neutral dipole ($r\gg d$), how does its potential depend on distance: $\varphi\propto r^n$, what is $n$?
question_uz: Neytral dipol potensiali undan uzoqda ($r\gg d$) masofaga qanday bog'liq: $\varphi\propto r^n$, $n$ nimaga teng?
question_ru: Как потенциал нейтрального диполя зависит от расстояния вдали ($r\gg d$): $\varphi\propto r^n$, чему равно $n$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Monopol hadi nol, birinchi nol bo'lmagan had dipol: φ = kp·cosθ/r². Maydon esa 1/r³.
Asos: dipol potensiali.

uz: Multipol yoyilmasining birinchi nol bo'lmagan hadi: $$\varphi=\frac{kp\cos\theta}{r^2}\propto r^{-2}$$
ru: Первый ненулевой член мультипольного разложения: $$\varphi=\frac{kp\cos\theta}{r^2}\propto r^{-2}$$
en: The first non-zero term of the multipole expansion: $$\varphi=\frac{kp\cos\theta}{r^2}\propto r^{-2}$$

distractors.E: neytral bo'lgani uchun nol deb olingan

distractors_en.C: the potential of a uniform field
distractors_en.E: taken as zero because it is neutral

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», multipollar g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: Of three identical capacitors $C$, two are connected in series and the third is connected in parallel with them. What is the equivalent capacitance?
question_uz: Uchta bir xil $C$ kondensatordan ikkitasi ketma-ket ulangan, uchinchisi ularga parallel ulangan. Umumiy sig'im qancha?
question_ru: Из трёх одинаковых конденсаторов $C$ два соединены последовательно, а третий подключён к ним параллельно. Какова общая ёмкость?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Ketma-ket juftlik C/2, unga parallel C qo'shiladi: C/2 + C = 3C/2.
Asos: parallel va ketma-ket ulash.

distractors.D: juftlik C deb olingan, so'ng ketma-ket

distractors_en.D: the pair taken as C, then series

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 8.43-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: The plates of a spherical capacitor have radii $a$ and $2a$. What is its capacitance?
question_uz: Sferik kondensator qoplamalarining radiuslari $a$ va $2a$. Uning sig'imi qancha?
question_ru: Радиусы обкладок сферического конденсатора $a$ и $2a$. Какова его ёмкость?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. C = 4πε₀ab/(b − a) = 4πε₀·2a²/a = 8πε₀a — yakkalangan shardan ikki marta katta.
Asos: sferik kondensator.

distractors_en.D: the denominator was taken as a/2
distractors_en.E: the denominator was taken as a + 2a

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 8.25-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A capacitor $C$ charged to voltage $U$ is disconnected from the source and connected in parallel to an identical uncharged capacitor. What fraction of the initial energy is lost?
question_uz: $U$ kuchlanishgacha zaryadlangan $C$ kondensator manbadan uzilib, xuddi shunday zaryadsiz kondensatorga parallel ulandi. Boshlang'ich energiyaning qancha ulushi yo'qoladi?
question_ru: Конденсатор $C$, заряженный до напряжения $U$, отключили от источника и подключили параллельно к такому же незаряженному конденсатору. Какая доля начальной энергии теряется?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Zaryad saqlanadi: U' = U/2. Energiya 2C·(U/2)²/2 = CU²/4 — boshlang'ichning yarmi.
Asos: zaryad saqlanishi.

distractors.D: faqat bitta kondensator energiyasi qoldi deb olingan

distractors_en.A: energy was assumed to be conserved
distractors_en.D: only one capacitor's energy was kept

source: original (B2-L13, energiya yo'qotilishi)

question_en: The figure shows the potential $\varphi(x)$ along the $x$ axis. What is the field component $E_x$ at $x=0.35\ \mathrm{m}$?
question_uz: Rasmda $x$ o'qi bo'ylab potensial $\varphi(x)$ grafigi berilgan. $x=0.35\ \mathrm{m}$ nuqtada maydonning $E_x$ tashkil etuvchisi nimaga teng?
question_ru: На рисунке дан график потенциала $\varphi(x)$ вдоль оси $x$. Чему равна составляющая поля $E_x$ в точке $x=0.35\ \mathrm{m}$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. 0.3–0.4 m da φ 30 V dan −30 V ga tushadi: dφ/dx = −600 V/m, E = −dφ/dx = +600 V/m.
Asos: maydon va potensial.

distractors.E: x = 0.35 m da potensial nolga yaqin, shuning uchun maydon nol deb olingan

distractors_ru.E: потенциал близок к нулю, поле взято нулевым

distractors_en.C: the first segment's slope with the wrong sign
distractors_en.E: the potential is near zero, so the field was taken as zero

source: original (B2-L13, φ(x) grafigi)

question_en: A ring of radius $R$ carries a uniform charge $+Q$. A particle of mass $m$ and charge $-q$ is displaced slightly from the ring's centre along the axis and released. What is the angular frequency of small oscillations?
question_uz: Radiusi $R$ bo'lgan halqa $+Q$ zaryad bilan bir tekis zaryadlangan. Massasi $m$, zaryadi $-q$ bo'lgan zarra halqa markazidan o'q bo'ylab biroz siljitilib qo'yib yuborildi. Kichik tebranishlar burchak chastotasi qancha?
question_ru: Кольцо радиусом $R$ равномерно заряжено зарядом $+Q$. Частицу массой $m$ с зарядом $-q$ немного сместили из центра кольца вдоль оси и отпустили. Какова угловая частота малых колебаний?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. O'qda E ≈ kQz/R³, kuch −kQqz/R³ — prujinadek, k' = kQq/R³, ω = √(kQq/(mR³)).
Asos: halqa potensiali.

distractors_en.E: the square root was not taken

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», halqa o'qidagi tebranish g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: The electric field in air is $10^6\ \mathrm{V/m}$. Roughly what is the field energy density ($\varepsilon_0=8.85\cdot10^{-12}\ \mathrm{F/m}$), in $\mathrm{J/m^3}$?
question_uz: Havoda maydon kuchlanganligi $10^6\ \mathrm{V/m}$. Maydon energiyasi zichligi taxminan qancha ($\varepsilon_0=8.85\cdot10^{-12}\ \mathrm{F/m}$), $\mathrm{J/m^3}$ da?
question_ru: Напряжённость поля в воздухе $10^6\ \mathrm{V/m}$. Какова примерно плотность энергии поля ($\varepsilon_0=8.85\cdot10^{-12}\ \mathrm{F/m}$), в $\mathrm{J/m^3}$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. w = ε₀E²/2 = 8.85·10⁻¹²·10¹²/2 ≈ 4.4 J/m³.
Asos: maydon energiyasi zichligi.
source: original (B2-L13, energiya zichligi)

question_en: A thin ring and a thin disk of the same radius $R$ are uniformly charged with the same charge $Q$. What is the ratio of the potential at the disk's centre to that at the ring's centre?
question_uz: Bir xil $Q$ zaryad va $R$ radiusli ingichka halqa va yupqa disk bir tekis zaryadlangan. Disk markazidagi potensialning halqa markazidagi potensialga nisbati qancha?
question_ru: Тонкое кольцо и тонкий диск одинакового радиуса $R$ равномерно заряжены одинаковым зарядом $Q$. Каково отношение потенциала в центре диска к потенциалу в центре кольца?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Halqa: kQ/R. Disk: σR/(2ε₀) = 2kQ/R — zaryad markazga yaqinroq. Nisbat 2.
Asos: uzluksiz taqsimot potensiali.

ru: В центре диска — сумма колец: $$\varphi=\int_0^R\frac{k\sigma2\pi s\,ds}{s}=\frac{2kQ}{R}$$
en: At the disk's centre — a sum of rings: $$\varphi=\int_0^R\frac{k\sigma2\pi s\,ds}{s}=\frac{2kQ}{R}$$

distractors.A: barcha zaryad R masofada deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: весь заряд взят на расстоянии R

distractors_en.A: all the charge was placed at distance R

source: original (B2-L13, disk va halqa)

question_en: Capacitors of $1\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ and $2\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ are connected in series across a $9\ \mathrm{V}$ source. What is the voltage, in volts, across the $1\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ capacitor?
question_uz: $1\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ va $2\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ kondensatorlar ketma-ket ulanib, $9\ \mathrm{V}$ manbaga ulangan. $1\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ kondensatordagi kuchlanish necha volt?
question_ru: Конденсаторы $1\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ и $2\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ соединены последовательно и подключены к источнику $9\ \mathrm{V}$. Сколько вольт на конденсаторе $1\ \mu\mathrm{F}$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Q bir xil: C = 2/3 μF, Q = 6 μC, U₁ = Q/C₁ = 6 V — kichik sig'imda katta kuchlanish.
Asos: ketma-ket ulash.

en: In series — the same charge: $$Q=\frac{C_1C_2}{C_1+C_2}U=6\ \mu\mathrm{C},\quad U_1=\frac{Q}{C_1}=6\ \mathrm{V}$$

distractors_en.A: the voltage was taken proportional to capacitance
distractors_en.E: the charge was taken as C₂U

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 8.45-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: The potential has the form $\varphi=\alpha xy$ ($\alpha>0$). What is the magnitude of the field at the point $(1;\ 2)$ (coordinates in metres)?
question_uz: Potensial $\varphi=\alpha xy$ ko'rinishida ($\alpha>0$). $(1;\ 2)$ nuqtada maydon kattaligi nimaga teng (koordinatalar metrda)?
question_ru: Потенциал имеет вид $\varphi=\alpha xy$ ($\alpha>0$). Какова величина поля в точке $(1;\ 2)$ (координаты в метрах)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. E = −∇φ = −(αy, αx) = −(2α, α); |E| = α·√(4 + 1) = √5·α.
Asos: maydon va potensial.

en: The gradient: $$\vec E=-\nabla\varphi=-(\alpha y,\ \alpha x)=-(2\alpha,\ \alpha),\quad E=\sqrt{5}\alpha$$

distractors_en.B: the components were taken as 1 and √2
distractors_en.C: the components were added without squaring

source: original (B2-L13, gradient)

question_en: In a spherically symmetric region the potential is $\varphi=\beta r^2$ ($\beta>0$). What is the charge density in this region?
question_uz: Sferik simmetrik sohada potensial $\varphi=\beta r^2$ ($\beta>0$). Shu sohadagi zaryad zichligi qancha?
question_ru: В сферически симметричной области потенциал $\varphi=\beta r^2$ ($\beta>0$). Какова плотность заряда в этой области?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Puasson: ∇²φ = (1/r²)d(r²·2βr)/dr = 6β, ρ = −ε₀·6β. Potensial markazda minimum — zaryad manfiy.
Asos: Puasson tenglamasi.

distractors_en.B: the one-dimensional second derivative was used

source: original (B2-L13, Puasson tenglamasi)

question_en: A parallel-plate capacitor of area $A$ carries charge $Q$ and is disconnected from the source. How much work is needed to slowly increase the gap from $d$ to $2d$?
question_uz: Yuzi $A$ bo'lgan yassi kondensator $Q$ zaryadga ega va manbadan uzilgan. Qoplamalar orasini $d$ dan $2d$ gacha sekin uzaytirish uchun qancha ish bajarish kerak?
question_ru: Плоский конденсатор с площадью $A$ имеет заряд $Q$ и отключён от источника. Какую работу нужно совершить, чтобы медленно увеличить зазор с $d$ до $2d$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Kuch F = Q²/(2ε₀A) masofaga bog'liq emas; ish F·d = Q²d/(2ε₀A) = W₂ − W₁.
Asos: qoplamalar kuchi.

en: The force is constant: $$A=F\cdot d=\frac{Q^2}{2\varepsilon_0A}\cdot d=\frac{Q^2d}{2\varepsilon_0A}$$

distractors_en.A: the force was taken as QE
distractors_en.C: energy was assumed to be conserved

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 8.39-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan
